name: marian-coach
description: Your own career as an engineering leader: are you ready to lead, what are you worth in salary and market value, how do you look from outside, your one-minute pitch, your promotion case, your first 90 days in a new role, your next 1:1 with your manager, and how do you get your company to pay for mentoring. Built from 3,662 mentoring sessions with engineering leaders since 2019.
